title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: protect files in excluded Windows folders
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap and tenant notice support its rollout, administrator opt-in and device prerequisite, and the current licensing table supports the listed Endpoint DLP suites. Minor corrections concern an uncited application-storage premise and checklist controls missing from the controls table.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans Endpoint DLP protection for files in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData.
claims.quote: Endpoint DLP now extends protection to files stored in commonly excluded Windows folders, including Temp and AppData.

claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators to review excluded paths for sensitive files and identify paths for the protected exclusion paths list.
claims.quote: Review excluded folder paths: Identify which excluded paths (such as AppData and temporary directories) contain or could contain sensitive files and should be added to the protected exclusion paths list.

claims.quote: Educate users and support teams: Inform them of expected behavior changes, including potentially blocked actions such as copy, print, or upload operations.

claims.claim: The existing Endpoint DLP settings documentation says files in excluded locations are not audited.
claims.quote: Files in excluded locations aren't audited.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Files created or modified in excluded locations are currently outside Endpoint DLP policy enforcement.
claims.quote: Any files that you create or modify in those locations aren't subject to DLP policy enforcement.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Learn lists two AppData paths as excluded by default.
claims.quote:
Windows file paths excluded by default
- `%SystemDrive%\\Users\\*(1)\\AppData\\Roaming`
- `%SystemDrive%\\Users\\*(1)\\AppData\\Local`

claims.claim: Applications store data in application-data and temporary folders.
claims.quote: The folders where your app can store data. These folders (local, roaming and temporary) are created when your app is installed.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/apps/develop/files/file-access-permissions to sources for the application-storage premise in 'Users and applications write to AppData and temporary folders'.

claims.claim: Existing Windows path exclusions are configured in Microsoft Purview portal > Data loss prevention > Overview > Data loss prevention settings > Endpoint settings > File path exclusions for Windows.
claims.quote: go to [Microsoft Purview portal](https://purview.microsoft.com) > **Data loss prevention** > **Overview** > **Data loss prevention settings** > **Endpoint settings** > **File path exclusions for Windows**.

claims.claim: Set-PolicyConfig -EndpointDlpGlobalSettings @(@{"Setting"="PathExclusion"; "Value"="<path>"}) configures the existing path exclusions.
claims.quote:
The EndpointDlpGlobalSettings parameter specifies the global endpoints.
Example values:
- `@{"Setting"="PathExclusion"; "Value"="C:\Windows";}`

claims.claim: Set-PolicyConfig is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: The existing endpoint path exclusions are tenant-level settings applying to all DLP policies for devices.
claims.quote: Centrally configured settings control many aspects of endpoint data loss prevention (DLP) behavior. These settings apply to all DLP policies for devices.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; controls[0].api; What's changing; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn has not yet documented the new excluded-folder protection or its enabling portal path or automation call.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP protect excluded folders protected exclusion paths Set-PolicyConfig roles licensing; "Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "Set-PolicyConfig". Opened dlp-configure-endpoint-settings and Set-PolicyConfig; found only existing exclusions.

claims.claim: The configuration scope of the new protection is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Endpoint DLP "protected exclusion" paths scope tenant policy. Read MC1384420, dlp-configure-endpoint-settings and Set-PolicyConfig; no scope for the new enabling setting was specified.

claims.claim: The notice describes no change to identity or permissions.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Endpoint DLP protected excluded folders configure permissions roles. Read MC1384420 in full and the endpoint-settings documentation; neither describes an identity or permissions change for this feature.

claims.claim: Which administrator roles can configure the new enabling setting is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP configure settings permissions role Compliance Administrator; protected excluded folders configure permissions roles. Read dlp-create-deploy-policy, endpoint settings and Set-PolicyConfig; policy roles are given, but no role for this new setting.

claims.claim: How editing the existing exclusion list interacts with the new setting is not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Endpoint DLP "protected exclusion" paths scope tenant policy. Read MC1384420, dlp-configure-endpoint-settings and Set-PolicyConfig; none explains interaction between the two lists.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The feature is covered by existing Endpoint DLP licensing for Windows endpoint protections.
claims.quote: It remains unchanged. This licensing model enables you to apply Microsoft Purview controls and protections to Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint-based assets.

claims.claim: The service description includes Endpoint DLP in Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5, Purview Suite/EDU/GOV/FLW, Defender + Purview Suite FLW, and Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5/G5 Information Protection & Governance.
claims.quote:
| Feature | Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/GOV/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5/G5 Information Protection & Governance |
| --- | --- |
| Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) | Included |

claims.quote: Searched: Endpoint DLP excluded folders protection AppData Temp licensing meter 562992. Read roadmap, MC1384420, Microsoft Purview service description and billing models; found existing Endpoint DLP entitlement, no change-specific additional licence.

claims.claim: No meter is documented specifically for this change.
claims.quote: Searched: "Endpoint DLP" "excluded folders" "billing"; Endpoint DLP excluded folders protection AppData Temp licensing meter 562992. Opened Purview billing models and service description; neither names a meter for this change.

claims.claim: Purview's per-user licensing model applies its controls and protections to Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint assets.
claims.quote: This licensing model enables you to apply Microsoft Purview controls and protections to Microsoft 365 and Windows/macOS endpoint-based assets.
